# Turn Knowledge Into Real-World Impact at Tyler Connect 2027


October 15, 2026


by Craig Patton


##


*“Connect is a great way to maximize and protect an agency’s investment. It’s a no-brainer when we consider what we can gain from this.”*
— Tyler Connect attendee


Getting more from the technology your organization relies on is one reason to attend Tyler Connect 2027. Connect also gives you an opportunity to look ahead — to deepen your product knowledge, explore how artificial intelligence (AI) and other emerging capabilities apply to government work, and bring home practical ideas your organization can put to use.


Join Tyler Technologies and thousands of public sector professionals **May 2-5, 2027, at the Henry B. González Convention Center in San Antonio, Texas** . At Connect, you’ll learn from Tyler experts, see technology in action, and exchange ideas with peers facing many of the same challenges.


## See AI at Work in Government


AI raises practical questions for public sector organizations: Where can it make a meaningful difference? How is it being used today? And how can organizations adopt it responsibly?


At Connect, those questions move beyond theory. Tyler experts will demonstrate how AI is being used in current products, and clients will share how they are using it to deliver results for their teams and communities.


Those perspectives can help you understand where AI may fit into your own work — from reducing routine tasks and helping teams use information more effectively to improving how services are delivered.


AI is one part of the conversation about what’s next. Connect also lets you explore cloud modernization and other technology developments shaping public sector work.


## Build the Connect Experience You Need


With hundreds of sessions, you can build a schedule around the products, skills, and issues that matter most to you and your organization.


Go deeper into a Tyler solution you use every day. Bring a technical question directly to a Tyler expert. Learn a feature or approach you can put to work when you return.


##### Everything Is Bigger at Connect! Plan Your Experience.


Explore sessions, experiences, travel, registration, and more on the[Tyler Connect 2027 site](https://www.tylertech.com/connect) .


If your role includes making broader technology or organizational decisions, you can evaluate where emerging technology may create value, learn how peers are approaching modernization, and explore ways to connect technology, data, and processes across your organization.


You can also look beyond the Tyler solutions you already know. Discover Tyler capabilities that may address other needs across your organization.


*“I enjoyed every session and took something away from each class. Meeting with Tyler team members face to face was invaluable.”*
— Tyler Connect 2026 attendee


## Learn From People Who Know Government


Some of the most useful moments at Connect begin with a question: **How did you handle this?**


A peer may have faced the same process problem, staffing challenge, or technology decision. A Tyler expert may know how another client approached a similar issue. A session can turn into a conversation about what worked, what didn’t, and what someone learned along the way.


Connect brings together hundreds of Tyler team members and thousands of public sector professionals with firsthand experience in government work. That shared context means you can spend less time explaining the environment and more time talking about how to solve the problem.


*“Really appreciated the support hub and all the staff who made themselves available even earlier and stayed later.”*
— Tyler Connect 2026 attendee


## Build Connections That Last Beyond Connect


Networking events and informal conversations give you time to continue discussions, compare experiences, and build relationships with peers and Tyler team members you can draw on after you return home.


And, yes, there’s time to enjoy San Antonio together.


## Bring More Than Notes Home


The value of Connect isn’t limited to four days in San Antonio. It’s what you can put to work afterward.


You might return with a better way to use a Tyler solution your team already has. An answer to a workflow problem. An idea from another public sector organization. A clearer perspective on a technology decision. A new Tyler capability worth exploring. Or a relationship you can continue learning from.


Together, those gains can make everyday work easier, inform broader technology and modernization decisions, and create new opportunities across your organization.


[Registration opens soon!](https://www.tylertech.com/connect) **Join us May 2-5, 2027, in San Antonio, Texas** .
